headline: Iraq Investment Commission Reviews $1 Billion Urea Plant for Basra
summary: Iraq's National Investment Commission is reviewing a proposed urea fertilizer production facility in Basra valued at over $1 billion, developed in partnership with Galiawa Group.
why: Urea investments bolster domestic petrochemical output and support agricultural input self-sufficiency in the Middle East.

impacts.name: Iraq
impacts.why: NIC consideration of a $1B+ fertilizer facility will expand domestic petrochemical production in Basra.
